verdict.rationale: BILL documents a REST v3 API that covers Spend & Expense, explicitly for managing transactions and reimbursements, with an S&E recipe for users, budgets and cards and an S&E apiToken. However, nothing shows OAuth or scoped tokens: the only S&E auth evidence is a plain apiToken. Nothing shows receipts can be retrieved either, since documented attachments cover vendors, customers, invoices and bills. Missing for 10: OAuth authorization flow, scoped/least-privilege tokens, receipt retrieval endpoints for S&E, detailed S&E transaction/expense endpoint docs, independent corroboration.
